description.value: Booster Juice is a Canadian smoothie and juice bar chain founded in 1999 in Alberta, now one of the country's largest fresh-beverage franchises. This Okanagan & Thompson location serves blended smoothies, fresh juices, açai bowls, and grab-and-go snacks in a fast-food format. It offers a quick, health-oriented refuelling stop for cyclists passing through the area.
